Moses and Aaron among his priests Ps 99:6 includes Moses (against P ). Zion's priests clothed with righteousness and salvation Ps 132:9 ; Ps 132:16 = 2Chr 6:41 , probably here also. 5. Levitical priests הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם Deut 17:9 ; Deut 17:18 ; Deut 18:1 ; Deut 24:8 ; Deut 27:9 ; Josh 3:3 ; Josh 8:33 (all D ), Jer 33:18 (inverted), v Jer 33:21 (neither in ᵐ5 ), 2Chr 5:5 (= ׳ הַכּ ׳ וְהַלּ 1Kgs 8:4 : Chronicler retains original Deuteronomic reading), Ezek 43:19 ; Ezek 44:15 (compare 6 ); בְּנֵי לִוֵי ׳ הַכּ Deut 21:5 ; Deut 31:9 ׳ לל ׳ לקח לכ Isa 66:21 take for priests, for Levites (of the nations in Messianic age). Aaronic priests. In the literature of the restoration הַכֹּהֵן is used of Ezra, Ezra 7:11 ; Ezra 10:10 ; Ezra 10:16 ; Neh 8:2 ; Neh 8:9 ; Neh 12:26 Uriah Ezra 8:33 Eliashib Neh 13:4 Shelemiah Neh 13:13 הכהנים Joel 1:9 ; Joel 1:13 ; Joel 2:17 ; Hag 2:11 ; Hag 2:12 ; Hag 2:13 ; Zech 7:5 ; Mal 1:6 ; Mal 2:1 priests and prophets Zech 7:3 כהן Mal 2:7 . 8. the high priest: הַכֹּהֵן is frequently used (see 4 ) to designate the priest who was at the head of priestly affairs . The adjective הַגָּדוֺל first appears of Jehoiada 2Kgs 12:11 , then of Hilkiah 2Kgs 22:4 ; 2Kgs 22:8 ; 2Kgs 23:4 ; 2Kgs 2:9 after the exile, of Joshua Hag 1:1 ; Hag 1:12 ; Hag 1:14 ; Hag 2:2 ; Hag 2:4 ; Zech 3:1 ; Zech 3:8 ; Zech 6:11 , and Eliashib Neh 3:1 ; Neh 3:20 ; Neh 13:28 . But P uses it of Aaron and his eldest descendants who are anointed with holy oil Lev 21:10 ( H ; הַגָּדוֺל מֵאֶחָיו ׳ הכ ), Num 35:25 ; Num 35:28 (twice in verse); Josh 20:6 , and so הַמָּשִׁיחַ ׳ הַכּ Lev 4:3 ; Lev 4:5 ; Lev 4:16 ; Lev 6:15 , compare Lev 16:32 . הָראֹשׁ ׳ כ is used of Seraiah 2Kgs 25:18 = Jer 52:24 and, in Chronicler, of Amariah 2Chr 19:11 , Jehoiada 2Chr 24:11 , Azariah 2Chr 26:20 ; 2Chr 31:10 of Aaron, Ezra 7:5 . ( We also supposes הרואה in 2Sam 15:27 to be a corruption of הראשׁ , which he regards as post-exilic insertion. The test is corrupt [see Dr Sm. 1.c .]; but this correction is improbable. Lists of high priests occur 1Chr 5:30 -41; 1Chr 6:35-38 .) A priest of second rank ( (ה)מִשְׁנֶה כֹּהֵן ) appears in 2Kgs 23:4 (construct plural incorrect), 2Kgs 25:18 = Jer 52:24 ׳ זִקְנֵי הַכּ 2Kgs 19:2 = Isa 37:2 ; Jer 19:1 ׳ שָׂרֵי הַכּ 2Chr 36:14 ; Ezra 8:24 ; Ezra 8:29 ; Ezra 10:5 ׳ רָאשֵׁי הַכּ Neh 12:7 .

Doubtless of same class are: הַכֹּהֲנִים Deut 18:3; Deut 19:17; Josh 3:6; Josh 3:8; Josh 4:11 (D); and הַכֹּהֵן, the priest officiating on a particular occasion Deut 18:3; Deut 20:2 or holding a particular dignity Deut 17:12; Deut 26:3; Deut 26:4. The כהנים of the other cities of Judah, הבמות ׳כ, who were not allowed to minister in Jerusalem 2Kgs 23:8 (twice in verse); 2Kgs 23:9; 2Kgs 23:20, may be an attempt to enforce an exclusion from the priesthood of all but Levitical priests.
6. Zadokite priests: Ezekiel distinguishes among הכהנים הלוים those of the seed of Zadok, בְּנֵי צָדוֺק; all but the latter excluded by him from priesthood Ezek 40:46; Ezek 43:19; Ezek 44:15; Ezek 48:11 the priests of his code being all Zadokites Ezek 40:45; Ezek 40:46; Ezek 42:13; Ezek 42:14; Ezek 43:24; Ezek 43:27; Ezek 44:21; Ezek 44:22; Ezek 44:30 (twice in verse); Ezek 44:31; Ezek 45:4; Ezek 45:19; Ezek 46:2; Ezek 46:19; Ezek 46:20; Ezek 48:10; Ezek 48:13.
7. Aaronic priests. In H. it is taken for granted that a priest is of the seed of Aaron; the plural is never used; כֹּהֵן is used for any priest Lev 21:9; Lev 22:10; Lev 22:11; Lev 22:12; Lev 22:13 הַכֹּהֵן for Aaron Lev 21:21, and for the official priest (acting for the priesthood, almost collective) Lev 17:5; Lev 17:6; Lev 22:14; Lev 23:10; Lev 23:11; Lev 23:20 (twice in verse); Lev 27:8 (3 t. in verse); Lev 27:11; Lev 27:12 (twice in verse); Lev 27:14 (twice in verse); Lev 27:18; Lev 27:21; Lev 27:23. The priests of P are בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן Lev 1:5; Lev 1:8; Lev 1:11; Lev 2:2; Lev 3:2; Lev 21:1; Num 3:3; Num 10:8; Josh 21:19 so in Chronicles 2Chr 13:9; 2Chr 13:10; 2Chr 26:18; 2Chr 29:21; 2Chr 31:19; 2Chr 35:14 (twice in verse); הַכֹּהֵן is used of Aaron 22 t., Eleazar 29 t., Phinehas Josh 22:30 and elsewhere; 180 t. of ministering priests, or generic of the priests; הכהנים Lev 6:22; Lev 7:6; Lev 13:2; Lev 16:33; כהן Lev 6:16. In the literature of the restoration הַכֹּהֵן is used of Ezra, Ezra 7:11; Ezra 10:10; Ezra 10:16; Neh 8:2; Neh 8:9; Neh 12:26 Uriah Ezra 8:33 Eliashib Neh 13:4 Shelemiah Neh 13:13 הכהנים Joel 1:9; Joel 1:13; Joel 2:17; Hag 2:11; Hag 2:12; Hag 2:13; Zech 7:5; Mal 1:6; Mal 2:1 priests and prophets Zech 7:3 כהן Mal 2:7.
8. the high priest: הַכֹּהֵן is frequently used (see 4) to designate the priest who was at the head of priestly affairs. The adjective הַגָּדוֺל first appears of Jehoiada 2Kgs 12:11, then of Hilkiah 2Kgs 22:4; 2Kgs 22:8; 2Kgs 23:4; 2Kgs 2:9 after the exile, of Joshua Hag 1:1; Hag 1:12; Hag 1:14; Hag 2:2; Hag 2:4; Zech 3:1; Zech 3:8; Zech 6:11, and Eliashib Neh 3:1; Neh 3:20; Neh 13:28. But P uses it of Aaron and his eldest descendants who are anointed with holy oil Lev 21:10 (H; הַגָּדוֺל מֵאֶחָיו ׳הכ), Num 35:25; Num 35:28 (twice in verse); Josh 20:6, and so הַמָּשִׁיחַ ׳הַכּ Lev 4:3; Lev 4:5; Lev 4:16; Lev 6:15, compare Lev 16:32. הָראֹשׁ ׳כ is used of Seraiah 2Kgs 25:18 = Jer 52:24 and, in Chronicler, of Amariah 2Chr 19:11, Jehoiada 2Chr 24:11, Azariah 2Chr 26:20; 2Chr 31:10 of Aaron, Ezra 7:5. (We also supposes הרואה in 2Sam 15:27 to be a corruption of הראשׁ, which he regards as post-exilic insertion. The test is corrupt [see DrSm. 1.c.]; but this correction is improbable. Lists of high priests occur 1Chr 5:30-41; 1Chr 6:35-38.) A priest of second rank ((ה)מִשְׁנֶה כֹּהֵן) appears in 2Kgs 23:4 (construct plural incorrect), 2Kgs 25:18 = Jer 52:24 ׳זִקְנֵי הַכּ 2Kgs 19:2 = Isa 37:2; Jer 19:1 ׳שָׂרֵי הַכּ 2Chr 36:14; Ezra 8:24; Ezra 8:29; Ezra 10:5 ׳רָאשֵׁי הַכּ Neh 12:7.
